name: fabeo
description: Make finished, branded videos from a chat: write and edit a scene-by-scene script, then render it with your Fabeo account.

interface.longDescription:
Fabeo turns a short brief into a finished, multi-scene video with a voice-over and background music. Describe the product, audience and message, and Fabeo writes a scene-by-scene script for you to review. Edit any scene in plain language and render only when you approve. You can start from one of Fabeo's video styles (product demo, explainer, social ad, UGC-style, before and after, animation, cinematic trailer) or from a template, use your own product photos as references, and regenerate a single scene instead of the whole video. Finished videos are vertical (9:16) or widescreen (16:9), up to 2 minutes long, and saved in your Fabeo account, where you can download them or share them for client review.

Who it is for: marketing teams, agencies and online stores that need product videos and ads without a production crew.

What you need: a Fabeo account. ChatGPT asks you to confirm before Fabeo renders, regenerates or deletes anything.

Limits: Fabeo makes videos with narration and music, not silent clips or GIFs, and it is not built for long-form video or avatar presenters. Renders take about 10 to 15 minutes.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second vertical video for my product. Show me the script first.
Shorten the hook in scene 1 and end with 'Shop now'.
Show my recent videos and their status.

positive.prompt: What kinds of videos can Fabeo make for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Fabeo's video styles, the ways to start (brief, template, product photos) and the account's remaining credits. Nothing is created or charged.

positive.prompt: Use Fabeo to write a 30-second vertical product video for a stainless steel water bottle aimed at commuters. Show me the script scene by scene first.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft and shows a scene-by-scene script with narration. No credits are spent and nothing is rendered.

positive.description: Edit one scene in plain language
positive.prompt: In that script, make the hook in scene 1 shorter and change the final call to action to 'Shop now'.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates only the requested scenes and shows the revised script. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Estimate cost, then render after confirmation
positive.prompt: How many credits will this video cost to render? If it is under 40 credits, render it.
positive.expected_behavior: States the estimated credits (about 1 per rendered second), asks the user to confirm, then starts the render and reports that it takes about 10 to 15 minutes.

positive.prompt: Show my recent Fabeo videos and the status of the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's videos with their status, and for the latest one shows progress or a link to the finished video.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not use Fabeo
negative.prompt: What is the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Purchase request should not trigger a purchase
negative.prompt: Buy more Fabeo credits for my account with my card.

review.commerce_description: Fabeo does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Rendering uses credits from the user's existing Fabeo account.

publication.release_notes: Removes the duplicate edit_scene_narration tool. To change a scene's spoken line, Fabeo now uses edit_scene, which already handled narration along with other scene changes.
